method.clock: Actual C buy E identifies original fixed-H10 execution date E+10 using the same full1642-session account calendar. C actual exit strictly before E+10 is early. The immediately next C entry is accelerated iff it occurs on or before that previous cycle original E+10 exit date. Reserve rule earliest next entry would be E+11 after checking conditions at E+10close.
method.classification: Every actual C entry is FIRST_ENTRY, AFTER_NON_EARLY_EXIT, or after an early exit either before/on or after its original H10 date. B entry match is a separate dimension, based only on equal actual entry dates.
method.return: Per-cycle actual residual-cash-aware cycle log return; closed fills include fees, cutoff OPEN uses actual NAV close with no hypothetical exit fee. Positive and negative sums are both shown.
method.year: Entry-year cohorts, not calendar-year NAV returns. WITHOUT2026 actually marks at2025-12-31, not deletion of2026entry rows.
method.scope: Timing diagnostic from existing evidence; no hypothetical reserve account is run. Each classification uses the immediately preceding actual C cycle, not a simulated chain under a reserve rule.

limits: Removing accelerated C trades is not a tradable strategy return; preserving old clocks can change later entries, quantities, cash and blocked orders.
C-only classification and all realized profits are retrospective labels; none can be used as a live signal.
Positive counterexamples are retained; evidence does not prove cooling down improves every year or satisfies the original objectives.
If later tested, reserve timestamp is determined at actual buy E, using elapsed session count only; no future price is required.
